A closer look

Understand the details.

The manufacturer presents hydrogen water as one of the system’s three modes. The accompanying bottle is an accessory to understand in context: ask which equipment is required and follow the instructions for the actual model.

  • Hydrogen water is water containing dissolved molecular hydrogen
  • A bottle accessory is shown in the supplied package material
  • Water preparation is separate from the inhalation mode
  • Confirm compatible water, preparation and cleaning instructions

Manufacturer information describes the product platform; confirm the specific unit and accessories supplied by Farra. Styled imagery is illustrative.
